funFacts: Reuters: Kane 88th and 89th England goals on cap 124.
The Premier League does not restart until 10 October.

keyPlayers.name: Harry Kane
keyPlayers.hook: Goals in the 8th and 53rd minutes. 89 England goals, 124 caps.

headline: England 7-0 Croatia in Rijeka, Kane and Saka each twice
whyCareReason: A 7-0 away win in Nations League Group A3, with Spain on 9 points the same night and the Premier League frozen until 10 October.
teaser: Croatia 0-7 England. Kane 8 and 53, Bellingham 21, Gordon 39, Saka 45 and 68, Rogers 87. Half-time 0-4.
story: England beat Croatia 7-0 on 3 October at Stadion HNK Rijeka. BBC, Sky and Reuters print the same scorers. Spain beat Czechia 3-1 in Oviedo and lead the group with 9 points. City still have 15 from five. The league returns 10 October.
stakes: Group A3: Spain 9, England 6, Croatia 3, Czechia 0.
rivalryAngle: Kane reached 89 England goals on his 124th cap, one short of Shilton.
